steps.name: V2.0 Release Freeze & Protection
steps.summary: V2.0 was frozen as the protected release baseline; main/release controls and required CI gates were established to prevent unsafe changes.
steps.externalControl: GitHub branch protection and release controls remain in GitHub by design.

steps.name: Production Operations & Monitoring
steps.summary: Production/staging operational checks, local checksum-verified backups, CI, uptime monitoring and full staging QA were established. Advanced monitoring was later strengthened in Step 13.

steps.name: Real Client Onboarding System
steps.summary: Organization provisioning gained onboarding readiness, migration/training progress, target go-live, approval, access URLs, notes and audit tracking.

steps.name: Client Go-Live Implementation Kit
steps.summary: A platform implementation workspace was added for client requirements, branch setup, migration templates, UAT, handover, custom-domain/support guidance and print-ready checklists.

steps.name: Off-site Backup & Disaster Recovery
steps.summary: R2/S3-compatible off-site backup and DR code/runbooks are prepared, but real off-site storage, scheduled upload and isolated restore evidence are still required.
steps.externalControl: Bucket credentials, retention and restore execution must remain in secure infrastructure tooling.

steps.name: Final SaaS Production Audit
steps.summary: Final production audit validated tenancy isolation, RBAC, ERP/LMS/CRM/HR/Finance, billing/entitlements, security, migrations, CI/build and health readiness.

steps.name: End-to-End Client Onboarding Dry Run
steps.summary: A full synthetic client dry run proved provisioning, tenant isolation, plan alignment, onboarding readiness, branch setup, audit evidence and cleanup through READY/100%.

steps.name: Commercial Packaging & Pricing
steps.summary: Essentials, Growth, Professional and Enterprise pricing, limits, entitlements, billing rules, implementation fees, extras and discount guardrails were finalized.

steps.name: Sales, Legal & Client Documentation
steps.summary: Proposal, quotation/order form, SaaS agreement, SOW, SLA, DPA, privacy/AUP, data exit, security and handover documents were created and are now accessible from Platform Admin.

steps.name: Sales Lead-Generation & Acquisition System
steps.summary: Dedicated B2B SaaS sales CRM, public demo lead routing, scoring, qualification, plan recommendation, activities, follow-ups, dashboard and acquisition playbook were implemented.

steps.name: First Real Paying Client
steps.summary: Use the SaaS Sales pipeline, legal pack, provisioning and onboarding workflow to close, activate and go live with the first real external paying institution.
steps.externalControl: A real buyer decision, commercial acceptance and payment/activation cannot be fabricated by the platform.

steps.name: Formal Production Release
steps.summary: Create the formal commercial release/tag and release record after the first-client validation and final launch GO gate pass.
steps.externalControl: Git release/tag creation remains in protected source-control workflow.

steps.name: Advanced Monitoring & Operations
steps.summary: 15-minute off-host monitoring, persistent incident issues, operational worker health, Prometheus metrics, backup freshness health and P1/P2/P3 incident response were implemented.

steps.name: Final Launch Readiness
steps.summary: Machine-readable GO/HOLD launch gate, CI validation, launch-day runbook, ownership, rollback and final readiness controls were implemented. Current commercial launch decision remains HOLD until blockers are cleared.
